title: Rigidity for positive scalar curvature metrics on $S^n\setminus\Sigma$

title: Explicit norm relations with optimized or restricted subgroup support
statement:
Given a finite group $G$, find an explicit norm relation
\[
d=\sum_{1\ne H\le G} a_HN_Hb_H\quad\text{in }\mathbb Z[G],
\]
